com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Change a client's name while keeping its identity, existing invoices, portal routing and accounting data. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview renaming our selected fictional practice client to Fictional Meadow Logistics. Show its current name and stable ID, and wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_rename_client, after the user confirms that preview. confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
